1257|fe52f4ea.name: Keldric Boucher
1257|fe52f4ea.text: Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?

2327|2957a3a0.name: Shaina Fuller
2327|2957a3a0.text: Oh, a fellow Physician. I would be glad to teach you anything that would aid your journeys.

2409|c5ceacbe.name: Felicia Maline
2409|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

2457|105cd232.name: John Burnside
2457|105cd232.text: No one's ever stolen anything out of here. Not in the whole history of... the whole history!

2457|2237a3b1.name: John Burnside
2457|2237a3b1.text: Welcome to the Bank of Stormwind. We offer financial accounts and safety deposit boxes for valuable items. Do you already have an account with us sir?

2504|60988031.name: Donyal Tovald
2504|60988031.text: Please clean yourself before handling our tomes.

265|94d9e780.name: Madame Eva
265|94d9e780.text: I have sensed your coming for quite some time, $N.  It was written in the pattern of the stars.

268|f1060a41.name: Sirra Von'Indi
268|f1060a41.text: Greetings, $c! I have but one goal: the cataloging and recording of all knowledge related to the history of Duskwood and Darkshire. Perhaps you could help me in my endeavor?

344|d18fd3a5.name: Magistrate Solomon
344|d18fd3a5.text: Who is this $c who goes before the Court of Lakshire in the Kingdom of Stormwind?  State your business within this township, $R.  The orc threat to the Kingdom is far too great to squander time in idle conversation.

382|04802d87.name: Marshal Marris
382|04802d87.text: I don't have time to chat, citizen, but if you're willing to give us a hand against the orcs, then I'll find a use for you.

633|b8d58f51.name: Elaine Carevin
633|b8d58f51.text: It's dark times that have come, $c... All too soon will we lose everything... When the Light will forsake all but those who truly walk under the Light.

6790|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Trelayne
6790|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

931|c5ceacbe.name: Ariena Stormfeather
931|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

101-accept.name: Madame Eva
101-accept.text:
As the mystical taint creeps through the forest, the need for self-protection is undeniable, $N.  The winds whisper to me and they speak of a great danger which waits patiently for you in the near future.

If you wish to protect yourself, noble $c, bring to me 10 ghoul fangs, 10 skeleton fingers and 5 vials of spider venom.  For you I shall enchant a Totem of Infliction which will harm those who attempt violent acts against you.
101-accept.title: The Totem of Infliction

115-complete.name: Marshal Marris
115-complete.text: Thank you, $N.  I'll send these to be destroyed immediately.
115-complete.title: Shadow Magic

115-progress.name: Marshal Marris
115-progress.text: How goes your conflict with the shadowcasters?  Did you find the midnight orbs?
115-progress.title: Shadow Magic

1241-accept.name: Bishop DeLavey
1241-accept.text:
Recently a diplomat was sent to Theramore to meet with Jaina Proudmoore. That diplomat never arrived.

I believe the Defias are involved in this plot, but I'm not sure how. The diplomat's disappearance still eludes public attention, but it can't remain that way for long.

Agents of the king are already scouring the city for clues, but I have my own contacts I would like involved.

In the Valley of Heroes is an old friend of mine named Jorgen. Find him, give him this note, and follow his instructions.
1241-accept.title: The Missing Diplomat

126-complete.name: Verner Osgood
126-complete.text: Again, thank you for your help.  The Stormwind army is so busy dealing with the orcs, they don't have the troops to protect Redridge from local threats like the gnolls.
126-complete.title: Howling in the Hills

126-progress.name: Verner Osgood
126-progress.text: Yowler is a dangerous creature, $N.  If you're not ready for him, I understand.
126-progress.title: Howling in the Hills

1274-accept.name: Thomas
1274-accept.text:
Excuse me, sir. Bishop DeLavey asked me to approach adventurers that might be able to help him with a delicate matter.

If you could quietly head to Stormwind Keep and speak to him at your earliest convenience, I'm sure he would appreciate your help. Again, please be discreet. It is a matter of some importance.
1274-accept.title: The Missing Diplomat

1274-complete.name: Bishop DeLavey
1274-complete.text:
Hello, $N. I am Bishop DeLavey.

No doubt if you're asking me about my business here in the keep then young Thomas has succeeded in requisitioning you to help our kingdom. He has always been adept at following my requests.

I'm afraid I don't have time to elaborate much, so allow me to be blunt... and please, try to keep this from becoming common knowledge.
1274-complete.title: The Missing Diplomat

128-complete.name: Guard Howe
128-complete.text: I see you have fought valiantly against the Blackrock Clan, $C.  Your service to our township is great indeed.
128-complete.title: Blackrock Bounty

145-complete.name: Lord Ello Ebonlocke
145-complete.text: Thank you for making the long journey here.  This is indeed important information.
145-complete.title: Messenger to Darkshire

145-progress.name: Lord Ello Ebonlocke
145-progress.text: You appear to have traveled from afar, $C.  What business do you have here in Darkshire?
145-progress.title: Messenger to Darkshire

146-accept.name: Lord Ello Ebonlocke
146-accept.text:
If I did not know Magistrate Solomon personally, I would say the man has gone mad.  Send the Night Watch to Lakeshire because Stormwind refuses aid?  The Night Watch was formed because Stormwind left us when this foul magic seeped into the land.  If I sent my Night Watch, this town would be overrun by evil before the guards even reached the forest's edge.

Take this letter of response to your Master in Lakeshire.
146-accept.title: Messenger to Darkshire

163-accept.name: Elaine Carevin
163-accept.text:
Something's amiss at Raven Hill, $N. Calor swears that someone--or something--is haunting the buildings there. Two nights running he's noticed the shadows moving, and the third before that he says he saw light in one of the windows.

If, as you say, you care about the safety of Duskwood, find out what monster haunts in Raven Hill.
163-accept.title: Raven Hill

164-accept.name: Elaine Carevin
164-accept.text:
Do you know Sven? Now, there is a man who does the work of the Light! He and his followers keep a camp at the northwestern edge of Duskwood.

Unfortunately, because they are so few, they cannot even spare a man to fetch supplies from town. Will you deliver these supplies to him?
164-accept.title: Deliveries to Sven

165-accept.name: Elaine Carevin
165-accept.text: There was an old man who used to come into town to buy supplies rather frequently, but I haven't seen him for quite some time now. He lives out in a shack overlooking Raven Hill cemetery, if I remember correctly. Perhaps you should go see if something is amiss.
165-accept.title: The Hermit

169-complete.name: Magistrate Solomon
169-complete.text: Fantastic work, $N!  Gath'Ilzogg led those brutes into battle, killing many innocent humans.  Vindication is ours.  This is the first step in reclaiming the keep for the kingdom of Stormwind!
169-complete.title: WANTED: Gath'Ilzogg

173-accept.name: Calor
173-accept.text:
Darkness seems drawn inexorably to Duskwood. Master Carevin's quest is the expulsion of evil and heresy. Through our efforts are the people of Darkshire kept safe.

You believe yourself worthy to join us?

I once thought as you. Disillusioned by the complacency of the Watch, I joined Master Carevin. If you wish to prove yourself, it will not be through words.

Test your skills against the Nightbane Shadow Weaver worgen in Brightwood Grove--bright, hah!--and the Rotting Orchard.
173-accept.title: Worgen in the Woods

174-accept.name: Viktori Prism'Antras
174-accept.text:
My Gnomish friend, Cog, has promised to help me build a device which will let me peer towards the stars.  A truth exists, beyond magic, that can explain the strange transformation in the forest.

Bring to me a bronze tube made by a skilled engineer.  That is the first step, according to Cog's blueprint.
174-accept.title: Look to the Stars

180-complete.name: Magistrate Solomon
180-complete.text: So the evil Lieutenant Fangore is dead?  Good riddance to that foul creature.  You are very brave, $c.  The Township of Lakeshire thanks you for your aid.
180-complete.title: WANTED: Lieutenant Fangore

180-progress.name: Magistrate Solomon
180-progress.text: What news do you bring before the Court?
180-progress.title: WANTED: Lieutenant Fangore

19-complete.name: Marshal Marris
19-complete.text: Tharil'zun was a vicious, crafty orc.  Well done--I'm sure he didn't go down easy.  Here is your reward, $N.
19-complete.title: Tharil'zun

19-progress.name: Marshal Marris
19-progress.text: Orc pressure from Blackrock is still tense.  But have you at least rid us of Tharil'zun?
19-progress.title: Tharil'zun

219-accept.name: Corporal Keeshan
219-accept.text:
At last, friends of the Alliance!

Help... please... 

The last thing I remember these foul Orcs overpowered our regiment.  Most the men were killed. I took a strong blow to the head and everything went black. Now I am held captive in this cave.  Help me, I am hurt badly.

I'll need help getting back to town... please... you're my last hope...
219-accept.title: Missing In Action

219-complete.name: Marshal Marris
219-complete.text: You have served the Kingdom well, $C.  Thank you for assisting Corporal Keeshan with his escape from those dreaded Blackrock Orcs.  You shall be rewarded for your brave acts this day.
219-complete.title: Missing In Action

248-accept.name: Unknown
248-accept.text:
I have been watching the Tower of Ilgalar, and can detect that Morganth is in conflict with the Orcs in Stonewatch Keep.  I do not know the reason behind their contention, but you may aid me in unraveling this mystery.

Take another Glyph of Azora, then go to the top of the intact watch tower beside Stonewatch Keep.

Find a suitable object on which to place the Glyph.  A chest or a jar -- some place where the glyph will not be noticed -- will suit my purpose.
248-accept.title: Looking Further

248-complete.name: Unknown
248-complete.text: It is a suitable vessel for the Glyph of Azora, allowing Theocritus to delve into the minds within Stonewatch Keep.
248-complete.title: Looking Further

248-progress.name: Unknown
248-progress.text: This jar once held a foul-smelling liquor, but now lies empty and forgotten on a pair of barrels.
248-progress.title: Looking Further

249-accept.name: Unknown
249-accept.text:
After much observation, I have discovered Morganth's plans.

He searches for the Scythe of Elune...and he may have found it!  If he has, then the Redridge Mountains, and the kingdom of Stormwind, will soon feel his dark might.

I am not prepared to pit myself against Morganth, but I fear he must be dealt with now.  So you must enter the Tower of Ilgalar and face Morganth.

Defeat him, and bring me his Pendant of Shadow.  Do this, and the kingdom will owe you much.
249-accept.title: Morganth

249-complete.name: Theocritus
249-complete.text:
You have done well, $N.  In defeating the $c Morganth, Stormwind is saved from a grave peril.

I offer you this reward most humbly.  And I would bid you peace, if these were peaceful times.

But instead, I will bid you luck with your trials, and victory in the conflicts ahead.
249-complete.title: Morganth

249-progress.name: Theocritus
249-progress.text: Hurry, $N, before my fears of Morganth spreading his power are made real!
249-progress.title: Morganth

2746-complete.name: Tyrion
2746-complete.text:
These will do nicely, $N. Great job.

I have the rest of the gear I'll need in my pack... thank the Light I just got a tailor friend of mine to make me a silk bag. I was running out of room carrying all my gear around.

Before Spybot heads in, let's get the details set so you know what you have to do.
2746-complete.title: Items of Some Consequence

2746-progress.name: Tyrion
2746-progress.text:
I've been watching Lescovar for a couple weeks now. Trias has never trusted him, but we didn't suspect he was involved in anything to do with the Defias Brotherhood. We were following leads that tied him to the Twilight's Hammer. Either way, he's become more dangerous than this city can deal with, and that's where we come in.

Get me those items and we can put my plan into effect.
2746-progress.title: Items of Some Consequence

346-accept.name: Brother Paxton
346-accept.text: Now that I've finished copying the book, here's the original Stresses of Iron.  Thank you for your patience, and if you see Milton please tell him I'm sorry for the long delay.
346-accept.title: Return to Kristoff

346-complete.name: Brother Kristoff
346-complete.text: That's the one!  Thank you, $N.  May the Light shine brightly upon both your body and spirit!
346-complete.title: Return to Kristoff

346-progress.name: Brother Kristoff
346-progress.text: Were you able to find the book?
346-progress.title: Return to Kristoff

347-complete.name: Brother Paxton
347-complete.text:
Oh, splendid!  I can use this ore to make my dye, and then can finish copying The Stresses of Iron.

Thank you, $N!
347-complete.title: Rethban Ore

347-progress.name: Brother Paxton
347-progress.text: Do you have the Rethban Ore?
347-progress.title: Rethban Ore

394-accept.name: Elling Trias
394-accept.text:
Find Shaw in Old Town. Let him know that the Lescovar threat has been dealt with and about your involvement in the Lord's plots against the city. I'm sure he'll be proud to have another hero among Stormwind's citizens.

He'll more than likely send you off to meet with the Prince or some other noble. Don't let it get to your head, $N. The nobles can think they rule the city all they want, but some things remain out of their hands.
394-accept.title: The Head of the Beast

394-complete.name: Master Mathias Shaw
394-complete.text:
He is dead, then? Your justice was swift, $N. I pray to the Light that I never become your quarry!

<He laughs and claps you on the shoulder.>

I mean no criticism, $N. How could I, being the master of all assassins? But in truth, you have done the people of Stormwind a great service, and for that, I thank you.
394-complete.title: The Head of the Beast

395-accept.name: Master Mathias Shaw
395-accept.text:
Ah, I almost forgot. Alexston came while you were away, he wished to speak with you. No doubt he wishes to report the goings-on of the Defias Brotherhood to the nobles.

A bit of advice, $N: if anyone should ask, I would provide all details but that it was your hand that slew Lescovar. Trust me. I am... acquainted... with the ways of such things.

And as far as Trias goes, well, speak to no one of him... ever... if you can help it.
395-accept.title: Brotherhood's End

395-complete.name: Baros Alexston
395-complete.text:
It's good to see you, $N. I have heard that Lord Gregor Lescovar was found dead not long ago.

It would seem that you were successful in your mission. You have my gratitude that you have saved me, and many others, from VanCleef's revenge.
395-complete.title: Brotherhood's End

396-accept.name: Baros Alexston
396-accept.text:
I have prepared a report for the King. I believe you should be the one to deliver it to him, along with an account of your findings. Do not worry, there is no doubt that he will commend you for doing your duty to the people of Stormwind.

Your audience is scheduled soon, so you'd best hurry, it's a bit of a ways to Stormwind Keep.
396-accept.title: An Audience with the King

396-complete.name: Lady Katrana Prestor
396-complete.text:
You are to be commended for the service you have done for Stormwind, $N. If VanCleef had been successful in his machinations, he would no doubt have done considerable harm to the kingdom--something we must obviously avoid.

Take this, $c, as a token of the King's appreciation. I am only sorry he cannot present it to you himself, but he is away on a diplomatic mission and shall not return for some time.
396-complete.title: An Audience with the King

396-progress.name: Lady Katrana Prestor
396-progress.text: $N, yes? I was informed by Baros Alexston that you would be coming. I must say, I am most interested in what you have to say.
396-progress.title: An Audience with the King

434-accept.name: Tyrion
434-accept.text:
After I put on Spybot's disguise, he'll head in to talk to Lescovar. The guards should let him pass no problem.

While you were getting materials for me, I took care of informing Marzon that it was time for him and Lescovar to meet again. I even dropped some false information.

Lescovar will dismiss his guards and wait for Marzon out here in the garden. After you catch wind of talk about the Defias, make your move. You need to kill them both before the guards return! When you're done, speak to Trias.
434-accept.title: The Attack!

434-complete.name: Elling Trias
434-complete.text:
So it is done? Good. Thank you greatly for your discretion, $N. You've proven worthy on more than one count. I'll be sure to keep my eyes on you and your progress within the Alliance.

Be sure to keep your nose clean.
434-complete.title: The Attack!

56-accept.name: Commander Althea Ebonlocke
56-accept.text:
As Commander of The Night Watch it is my sworn duty to protect the citizens of Darkshire.  Stormwind has retracted their commissioned guards from their posts here, leaving us to our own devices.

If you feel worthy of the task, we need your help! Assist The Night Watch by venturing forth into Tranquil Gardens, just south of Darkshire, and slaying 8 Skeletal Warriors and 6 Skeletal Mages.  The undead threat must be thwarted!
56-accept.title: The Night Watch

579-progress.name: Donyal Tovald
579-progress.text: King Anduin has placed great importance on learning, and thus has provided funds for making copies of various tomes and writings available to the public. It's very simple. You bring me a library scrip, and I can give you a copy of one of the available books.
579-progress.title: Stormwind Library

66-accept.name: Madame Eva
66-accept.text:
Last night a horrible disturbance rippled through my veins.  I sensed that my granddaughter, Alyssa, was in great danger.  I consulted the cards and Death stared up at me from the table.

After taking a long journey through a dark trance I was able to uncover a clue to this terrifying mystery.  A name came to me, the name of Stalvan.

Seek out the Clerk in the Town Hall and see if you can find out more about this character.  I fear for us all.
66-accept.title: The Legend of Stalvan

66-complete.name: Clerk Daltry
66-complete.text: Ah so Madame Eva sent you. . . .
66-complete.title: The Legend of Stalvan

67-accept.name: Clerk Daltry
67-accept.text:
Stalvan, eh?  Let me check the town registry.

Stalvan. . .Stalvan. . .let's see.  Ah, here we go!  I have a record of a Mr. Stalvan Mistmantle.  The last recorded address is the Moonbrook Schoolhouse.  My, talk about outdated!

Do me a favor will you, friend?  If you happen to go out to Moonbrook, let me know if you get any update on this fellow.  I like to keep the records clean.
67-accept.title: The Legend of Stalvan

90-accept.name: Chef Grual
90-accept.text: Seasoned Wolf Kabobs are a house favorite!  Sure, I can make you some.  But first I'll need the supplies.  Bring me 10 Lean Wolf Flanks. Given the many wolves here in the forest, I am sure finding the Flanks will be no problem.  Fortunately for you, I just received my recent shipment of Stormwind Seasoning Herbs, so all I need are the flanks to get started.
90-accept.title: Seasoned Wolf Kabobs

91-complete.name: Bailiff Conacher
91-complete.text: The Court of Lakeshire recognizes your commitment to justice, $N.  By enforcing the laws of the Kingdom you have helped uphold the justice of the land.
91-complete.title: Solomon's Law

91-progress.name: Bailiff Conacher
91-progress.text: Turn in 10 Shadowhide Pendants to me, and you shall be rewarded.
91-progress.title: Solomon's Law

94-complete.name: Unknown
94-complete.text:
You place the Glyph of Azora on the stone.  It adheres itself ... and you hear from it Theocritus' disembodied voice:

You have my gratitude, young $N.  You may now speak with me through this Glyph, and I might have future tasks for you ... after I have probed the thoughts of my rival.
94-complete.title: A Watchful Eye

94-progress.name: Unknown
94-progress.text:
This Lion Statue has sat here for decades, and keeps a lonely watch over the infamous Tower of Ilgalar.

There is a depression at the base of the statue, where a gem or glyph might be set...
94-progress.title: A Watchful Eye
